target_platform.evidence_scope: Linux X11/Xvfb; software renderer requested; no physical display/IME qualification

managed_compilation.notes: Linux unprivileged UID65534, fresh home/Cargo cache, external-network-disabled run installed the packaged SDK. Before promotion, staged CPU template and annotated worker compiled/rendered PNGs. After promotion, a fresh worker project/target compiled and launched without network access. Host native linker/development prerequisites were preinstalled. Windows/macOS remain unqualified.

gpui_startup.notes: Native X11/Xvfb run confirmed 1,000 painted images and 2,000 verified real-worker renders, native keyboard input and UI heartbeat telemetry. Queue/current-image counters peaked at 1; 1,000 release requests, 0 failures. Physical-display GPU resources, pixels/alpha readback and real IME composition remain PENDING; this composite gate is not passed.

renderer_worker.notes: Linux X11 packaged GUI displayed actual managed-worker frames. Native force-crash reaped generation 1 while retaining its image and accepting keyboard input; restart 2 displayed pixels; changed-source rebuild 3 displayed the revised title. GUI close reaped the worker. Dedicated frame/control identities and deadlines covered by focused tests. Windows/macOS native isolation remains unqualified.

acp_task.notes: Configurable ACP v1 stdio sessions support streaming, permissions, same-session clarification replies, authoritative completion, isolated edits/rebuild and cancellation. Twelve ACP subprocess/unit tests pass. Authenticated adapter qualification remains NOT_RUN by user choice.

selection_anchor.notes: Linux native pointer events selected intro.title through painted letterbox geometry and showed its exact Rust snippet. Changing source after presentation rejected selection; managed rebuild generation3 displayed changed text and selected the refreshed span/snippet. Revision/generation/hash/path/ambiguous-marker cases also pass focused tests. Windows/macOS remain unqualified.

recommendations: Retain the isolated desktop workspace and owned external renderer process.
Qualify physical GPU pixel/alpha/readback/resource behavior and IME; execute Windows/macOS native gates before declaring Phase Zero qualified.
Configure an ACP adapter; authenticated edit/cancellation qualification remains deferred by user choice.
